title: Measure readiness, not activity, and report it by department
takeaway: Track a few signals recruiters screen on and show department numbers outside the cell, never activity or a ranked list.
sources: Activity counts reward students who are good at looking busy, and a report with thirty columns gets read once.
Login times, time spent on a page and keystrokes measure compliance, not readiness.
Faculty and heads of department need department and section numbers, not a ranked list of names.
A student who trusts the measurement uses it to decide what to work on.

cells.label: Department and section numbers
cells.note: the movement between runs is what heads of department see

cells.label: A ranked list of names
cells.note: students experience it as monitoring, and game it

cells.label: Hours logged, videos watched
cells.note: rewards students who are good at looking busy
